name: Ogata Souma
source:
Protagonist.

He was working as a company employee, but the job did not suit him and he was thinking of changing jobs. 

A relative asked him if he would be interested in becoming an apartment manager. He accepted the offer with a simple “yes”.

[From [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc074/character.html]official site[/url]]
